answer: A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the nectar proves it. The nectar here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Examined crossing keeper manifest writ is the proof, because a writ keepers sign after crossing audits. Each attempt carries a deposit of 77 credits, frozen until 10 days after the grading closes, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. Every crystal is counted once. The harbor is checked, not assumed.
